column3: ## Upload correctly  structured file and it is processed correctly
Setup: If you have not already, use the article_preservation testdrive to set up for this test at /testdrive/article_preservation
Setup: The static resource file below can be uploaded exactly as it is in the repo - no editing needed. Its identifiers.csv already points at an article owned by the 'with_preservation' account
Log in as the 'with_preservation' account supplied by the testdrive, if not already logged in

Select 'Browse' and select the package zip file

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/4380_test_scripts/doajtest/preservation_upload_test_package/valid_article.zip

column4: A flash message appears at the top of the screen: File uploaded and waiting to be processed.
Upload status is shown in 'History of uploads' with status processing

column3: wait a short amount of time for the job to process, then reload the page (do not re-submit the form data).  If the job remains in "pending", reload the page until the status changes.

column4: Upload status in 'History of uploads' changes to 'successfully processed' and the 'Notes' shows as 'uploaded to archive server'
